# Synthetic pinned projection fixtures

These JSON files were generated from synthetic typed rows through the unchanged pure projection functions in C108 `711e2fbd69598d06f43da9ff47de60d2c569634c` (`c3_types.py`, `c3_facts.py`) and C109 `e999232014be8b16717058c6d9b70b41dec75c89` (`c4_render.py`), using internal order models from C111 `2945e3d3b6ba187a510cfb715e22d9feb70c4408`.

They are source-generated JSON shapes, not captured HTTP responses, database records or production facts. There was no login, database, provider or image request. Identifiers, descriptions, scores and material declarations are synthetic. HTML-like strings deliberately test literal rendering.

The old closed order was submitted before the period and closed inside it. A different active order becomes overdue after the period end but before `domain_as_of`. Its snapshot stock must therefore remain distinct from the period flow. The human score is null in the primary fixture and exactly zero in the explicit zero variant; the separate stored rules recommendation has score 99. Material quantity 1.250 and decimal rate strings must remain lossless. Unavailable metrics and source limitations must not disappear.

C111 adds `provenance.historical_evidence` separately at the HTTP projection boundary. Tests constructing that optional field label it synthetic and use scoped counts, never treating the full-history 444 reference count as a universal UI constant.
